subject: RE: Emergency runtime workaround and short maintenance window
messages:
From: Alex King <alex.king@acmeanalytics.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: support@acmeanalytics.com
Date: 2027-10-03T14:08:22Z
Subject: Observed inference degradation — 5xx spikes and latency

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

We're seeing a burst of 5xx errors from the Redwood endpoint (model: rdx-13b-opt) for a subset of our high-concurrency routes. Median latency has jumped from ~120ms to >800ms and several customer-facing jobs are timing out. Sample traces attached.

Key details:
- First observed: 2027-10-03T13:55 UTC
- Affected region: us-west-2
- Error pattern: KV cache miss followed by repeated 5xx (upstream runtime crashes)

This is impacting critical nightly jobs for our billing pipeline. Can you confirm whether anything changed on the runtime side or if you recommend any immediate mitigations we can apply on our side?

Thanks,
Alex
Alex King
Engineering Lead, Data Integrations
Acme Analytics

[Attachment: acme_error_snippet.txt (text/plain) — snippets of request ids and stack traces]
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Alex King <alex.king@acmeanalytics.com>, Acme Support <support@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, david_kim <david@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T14:22:41Z
Subject: RE: Observed inference degradation — immediate mitigation and scheduled short maintenance

Alex — thanks for the report and the traces, really helpful. We're seeing correlated signals across several clusters in us-west-2; investigation points to a regression in a recent runtime memory candling change that increases KV cache miss handling under certain sequence-length distributions.

Immediate plan (short notice):
- We're preparing an emergency hotfix to adjust the KV cache path and add a guard for the memory edge-case.
- Target rollout: 2027-10-03T22:00 UTC (roughly 7h from now).
- Expected customer impact: brief request throttling and small number of 5–10s increased latencies for <15 minutes during rollout; we do not expect longer downtime but we will perform rolling restarts and may re-route traffic as needed.

Can you confirm whether Acme can accept a maintenance window at that time? If not, tell us the latest window you can tolerate and we'll try to accommodate. We'll also provide a rollback plan and a postmortem.

I'm including Marissa (CS) and Stephanie (Runtime lead) to coordinate the schedule and communications.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, david_kim <david@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T15:35:05Z
Subject: Internal: hotfix package and rollback plan (draft)

FYI — attaching the hotfix diff and a concise rollback procedure. Patch is a focused change to the cache-path early-exit and a safe-guard around the KV allocator. Tested on a subset cluster and reproduced the fix for the trace Alex sent.

Rollout notes:
- Rollout will be rolling restart by AZ to avoid region-wide blips (10% pods at a time).
- Health checks: we will monitor per-node 5xx and p95 latency; automated rollback if 5xx rate >2x baseline for 3 consecutive minutes.
- Rollback path: re-deploy previous build (tag: release-20270929) using the orchestration tool; estimated rollback time to full capacity: 8–12 minutes.

Attachments: hotfix_20271003.patch, rollback_plan_20271003.md

Stephanie Nguyen
Principal Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: hotfix_20271003.patch (text/x-patch)]
[Attachment: rollback_plan_20271003.md (text/markdown)]
From: Alex King <alex.king@acmeanalytics.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, support@acmeanalytics.com
Date: 2027-10-03T16:07:12Z
Subject: RE: Observed inference degradation — immediate mitigation and scheduled short maintenance

Vivek / Stephanie — thanks for the quick triage and proposed schedule. We can accept the 22:00 UTC window. Please go ahead with the rollout. Two asks from our side:
1) Please post a short notification on the status page ~15 minutes before the rollout. Our ops team will alert impacted partners.
2) After the fix, can you share a short postmortem and any recommended config changes for our production prompts to avoid similar edge-cases?

We'll stand by and let you know immediately if anything changes. Appreciate the rapid response.

—Alex
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Alex King <alex.king@acmeanalytics.com>, Acme Support <support@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, david_kim <david@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T18:45:10Z
Subject: RE: Observed inference degradation — immediate mitigation and scheduled short maintenance

Thanks Alex — confirmed. We'll: 
- Post a status update on status.redwood.com at 21:45 UTC (15 minutes before).
- Begin the rolling hotfix at 22:00 UTC, monitor live metrics, and keep you updated via this thread.
- Share a short postmortem within 48 hours and include suggested prompt/seq-length mitigations you can apply client-side.

If anything changes from the engineering side we'll call out a rollback and send an update within 5 minutes.

Regards,
Vivek
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
